provinceDeepAtlasProfile.extremeAtlasDescription: Zharvokh occupies  sq mi /  sq km of modeled Earth-sized territory. Its province terrain is led by Mountain range, Deep cavern, Hybrid tree and forest floor. Karag-Thûl, Kharévok, Moltharok, and Tharvokar carry the mountain record: Karag-Thûl occupies the whole mountain section it sits within and descends into caverns with underworld rumors, Kharévok sits between two ranges, Moltharok clings to a mountain side, and Tharvokar is deep mountain.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.peopleFactionsAndFaith: The strongest public people-groups are Humans, Near-Humans, and Mixed Heritage, Halfling and Smallfolk, Animalfolk and Mammalian Anthropomorphs, Dwarven and Gnomish Kin, Amphibious and Aquatic Peoples, Elf Parent Race and Elf Bloodlines, and 2 more. Faction visibility leans toward The Cog-Sanctum Synod, with worship and patronage records naming Nebyrr, Ishtanora, Iskareth, Marduthor, Bastveig, Setrimir, Sigrananna, and 3 more.

npcs.name: Abbot Wallwhite
npcs.description: Abbot Wallwhite is a meticulous Faerie wall painter who treats civic color, public morale, and visible maintenance as matters of political survival. He restores murals, boundary marks, warning signs, and city walls for the Brass Concordat, grumbling that people notice corruption faster when the paint stops being refreshed. Abbot can seem fussy, but his eye for surface damage often catches sabotage, hidden doors, ichor seepage, and blood washed badly from stone.
npcs.settlementAndAncestryTexture: Vulkradûn is a City in Zharvokh, under Military Regency, with high danger, Beach and grass with water, Farming, Partial forest terrain. Local records favor Altruistic, Lawful, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Halfling — Stout Halfling, Kender, Kithkin. Faerie reads through the Fey-Folk entry of the race compendium, within Fey and Trickster Folk, marked by Thalunesh. Fey-Folk are peoples shaped by glamour, luck, tiny or otherworldly bodies, dreamlike emotion, and trickster magic. At my table, Faerie, Fairy, and Gandirosha are not separate top-level races here; they are bloodlines. Table cues: Fey Creature Type or Fey Ancestry, Fey Magic, Glamour or Luck Expression, Small/Tiny Fey Presence; starting tendency Neutral - Chaotic - Cooperative - Neutral.
rumors: Abbot can identify three kinds of ichor leakage by how primer refuses to dry over them.
He once insulted a mayor's entire administration by repainting one wall exactly the color it had been before the scandal.
plotHooks: Abbot asks the party to guard a wall restoration after finding a message bleeding through seven layers of paint.
A civic mural begins changing overnight, showing crimes the watch has not yet discovered.
